title: 🏆 Oliver Collins wins People's Choice Award at 2026 JRA Poster Exhibition
summary: Oliver Collins, final-year student and research assistant, has been awarded the People's Choice Award at the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) Poster Exhibition.
content: Congratulations to Oliver Collins, final-year student and research assistant, who has won the People's Choice Award at the 2026 Junior Research Associate (JRA) Poster Exhibition!

Oliver's poster featured an ongoing research project exploring the relationship between visual illusions and the cardiac cycle, continuing the lab's line of work in understanding how perception and physiology shape each other.
We thank the Sussex Researcher School for their fantastic organisation of the JRA Scheme and Poster Exhibition, and send our congratulations to all the other JRA students!
